## What changes?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue if applicable.

## Validation

List checks you actually ran and any intentional skips. CI reports are the source of truth.
For UI changes, include a screenshot or a reproduction path.

## Boundaries and compatibility

Describe relevant SSR, remote contract, session or deployment effects.

- [ ] Documentation and handbook examples match the behavior.
- [ ] Generated build output, remote type archives and local reports are excluded.
- [ ] No real credentials, tokens or private user data are included.
